say:0:1410202001:0.source_cn: 特使大人快请！能接待您二位真是我们的荣幸！

say:2:1410203001:0.text: Welcome! It's a true privilege to host such esteemed guests!

say:4:1410203002:1.text: May I ask your name, good sir?

say:5:1410203003:1.text: I am Eldric, chief of <style="highlight">Brimstone Village</style>. It is an absolute honor to have you here!

say:6:1410203004:1.text: A pleasure to meet you, Chief Eldric. I am Hogan, the leader of this delegation.
say:6:1410203004:1.source_cn: 幸会，弗林村长，我是霍根，本次使节团的负责人。

say:7:1410203005:1.text: This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, our envoy mage, accompanied by his familiars.

say:8:1410203006:1.text: Oh my, what a pleasure to meet you both—no, all four of you, welcome!
say:8:1410203006:1.source_cn: 哎呀……二位好——哦不，四位好。

say:9:1410203007:1.text: Our humble village hardly seems worthy of such a grand delegation from the Empire.
say:9:1410203007:1.source_cn: 我们这座小小村庄，哪值得帝国如此兴师动众？

say:10:1410203008:1.text: To think that not just one but two envoys have come, and one of them is even a mage! What a rare honor indeed!
say:10:1410203008:1.source_cn: 竟然一下子见到两位特使……甚至还有一位魔法师？
say:10:1410203008:1.male: To think that not just one but two envoys have come, and one of them is even a mage! What a rare honor indeed!
say:10:1410203008:1.female: To think that not just one but two envoys have come, and one of them is even a mage! What a rare honor indeed!

say:11:1410203009:1.text: If our hospitality is lacking in any way, please do forgive us. We don't often have dealings with mages.

say:11:1410203009:1.female: If our hospitality is lacking in any way, please do forgive us. We don't often have dealings with mages.

say:13:1410203010:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，你……不喜欢魔法师吗？

say:14:1410203011:1.text: Oh, no, no, little familiar! Where did you get such an idea?
say:14:1410203011:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀呀……使魔大人！您这是说哪的话？

say:15:1410203012:1.text: Without mages enchanting our weapons, they'd never reach their full potential!
say:15:1410203012:1.source_cn: 如果没有魔法师帮忙附魔，我们制造的武器压根发挥不出真正威力。

say:17:1410203013:1.text: That's true! The magister enchanted a cannon for our dwarven friend, and that very cannon sank the entire Dead Tide Fleet!

say:17:1410203013:1.male: That's true! The magister enchanted a cannon for our dwarven friend, and that very cannon sank the entire Dead Tide Fleet!
say:17:1410203013:1.female: That's true! The magister enchanted a cannon for our dwarven friend, and that very cannon sank the entire Dead Tide Fleet!

say:18:1410203014:1.text: Shhh... He hasn't even spoken yet, and here you are, bragging about all his accomplishments.
say:18:1410203014:1.source_cn: 嘘……主人都还没说话，你倒是先用主人的功绩逞上威风了。
say:18:1410203014:1.male: Shhh... He hasn't even spoken yet, and here you are, bragging about all his accomplishments.
say:18:1410203014:1.female: Shhh... She hasn't even spoken yet, and here you are, bragging about all her accomplishments.

choice_prompt:23:1410203017.female: What? Has no one ever told you?

say:24:1410203018:1.text: Aha! I see now. You must be testing me!
say:24:1410203018:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈……我懂了，您是在试探我。

say:24:1410203018:1.female: Aha! I see now. You must be testing me!

say:25:1410203020:1.text: It's common knowledge throughout Esperia that we dwarves cannot wield magic.
say:25:1410203020:1.source_cn: 毕竟，我们无法使用魔法，这是耀光人人都知道的常识嘛。

say:26:1410203021:1.text: We have a unique constitution, you see. We're unable to perceive magic. No matter how much we study, it's beyond our grasp...
say:26:1410203021:1.source_cn: 我们矮人体质特殊，无法感知魔力。哪怕付出一生钻研，我们...

say:27:1410203022:1.text: Instead, we dwarves are gifted with great physical strength, long lifespans, and boundless talent for invention!
say:27:1410203022:1.source_cn: 呵呵，不过我们矮人拥有强健的体魄和漫长的生命！更别说我...

say:28:1410203023:1.text: If the price of these gifts is a lack of magic, I'd say it's a bargain!
say:28:1410203023:1.source_cn: 如果获得这些天赋的代价是不被魔法接纳，那也值了！

say:30:1410203024:1.text: Chief, you are truly a bold and optimistic man. You have my respect.
say:30:1410203024:1.source_cn: 弗林村长真是乐观豪迈，我十分佩服。

say:31:1410203025:1.text: Ah, honored envoy, your kind words flatter me! But enough of this. Surely, after such a long journey, you must be parched. Let us drink and talk!
say:31:1410203025:1.source_cn: 感谢特使大人夸奖！先不说这些了。各位远道而来肯定累得够...

say:32:1410203026:1.text: We appreciate your hospitality, but we are here on a mission. We'd like to check on the progress of our weapon order first.
say:32:1410203026:1.source_cn: 承蒙美意。只是，我们还有任务在身，想要先确认武器订单的进度。

say:33:1410203027:1.text: As you know, this order is large in scale and intricate in craftsmanship.
say:33:1410203027:1.source_cn: 您也知道，这次订单数量大，工艺也比较复杂。

say:34:1410203028:1.text: Ah, the one mentioned in your letters? Worry not! Our craftsmanship is second to none and quality and efficiency are our pride!
say:34:1410203028:1.source_cn: 就是之前的信函里提到的吧？您放一百个心，我们的质量和效...

say:35:1410203029:1.text: Of course. I've long heard of the exceptional skill of your village's craftsmen. However, duty calls. We must attend to the task at hand.
say:35:1410203029:1.source_cn: 当然，当然。村内的工匠个个技艺精湛，我早已耳闻。只是，...

say:36:1410203030:1.text: Rest assured! I'm not just boasting—our craftsmen aren't just master smiths; they're expert miners and prospectors as well!
say:36:1410203030:1.source_cn: 千万放心！不是我自吹自擂，我们深岩村的工匠不止擅长锻造...

say:37:1410203031:1.text: Dwarves from all over the world have traveled to learn from us and—
say:37:1410203031:1.source_cn: 就不少原本住在外地的同族也千里迢迢来这里学习，还有——

say:38:1410203032:1.text: *Ahem*... I believe we can discuss your village's many strengths once our business is concluded.
say:38:1410203032:1.source_cn: 这个……等我们办完正事，再听村长你仔细介绍也不迟。

say:39:1410203033:1.text: Ah, my apologies! When I start talking about Brimstone Village, I can't seem to stop.
say:39:1410203033:1.source_cn: 对不住！一说起我们村的厉害之处，我这嘴就刹不住了。

say:40:1410203034:1.text: Now, let me take you on a tour of our village. Please follow me.
say:40:1410203034:1.source_cn: 总之，各位请随我来，正好带各位贵客先视察视察敝村的风貌。

say:41:1410203035:1.source_cn: 好吧……恭敬不如从命，请带路。

narration:43:1410203036:1.text: Eldric leads the way, with Hogan following closely behind. Once they walk a little further, Chippy and Hammie stand on their toes, seemingly wanting to say something.

say:45:1410203037:1.text: Magister, General Hogan sure knows how to talk all fancy! No wonder he's an imperial general!
say:45:1410203037:1.source_cn: 主人，霍根将军说起场面话来也是一套一套的呢，不愧是帝国...
say:45:1410203037:1.male: Magister, General Hogan sure knows how to talk all fancy! No wonder he's an imperial general!
say:45:1410203037:1.female: Magister, General Hogan sure knows how to talk all fancy! No wonder he's an imperial general!

say:46:1410203038:1.text: Oh, the village chief's got a lot to say too! Chippy thought all dwarves were like Hugin though...
say:46:1410203038:1.source_cn: 这位村长也能说会道，我还以为所有矮人都是呼金那样的。

say:47:1410203039:1.text: Even though he's enthusiastic, I get the feeling that he's... not entirely sincere? He's got a totally different vibe from Hugin.

say:49:1410203040:1.text: Hmm, I hope it's just me being paranoid.

say:53:1410203045:1.text: Let's go! We should catch up with General Hogan.
say:53:1410203045:1.source_cn: 走吧主人，我们得跟上霍根将军啦。
say:53:1410203045:1.male: Let's go! We should catch up with General Hogan.
say:53:1410203045:1.female: Let's go! We should catch up with General Hogan.

say:55:1410203046:1.text: Right! This is our first time in a dwarven village, so we can enjoy the sights while staying focused on our mission. It already looks so different from Artisan Avenue in Whiteridge!

say:56:1410203047:1.text: Magister! General Hogan's pretty far from us now. We better catch up!

say:0:1410203301:0.text: Please take the lift up to enter the village.
say:0:1410203301:0.source_cn: 请诸位乘坐升降机上行进入村子里。

say:0:1410204001:0.text: You built a lift on this steep cliff?
say:0:1410204001:0.source_cn: 你们在陡峭的悬崖上造了一座升降机？

say:1:1410204002:0.text: Ha, of course! A lift is the best way to make the climb easy.
say:1:1410204002:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，山上升降机往来更为便利，走山路不就白费了我们的技艺吗？

say:0:1410207001:0.text: Come, take a look. This is what true dwarven craftsmanship is like!
say:0:1410207001:0.source_cn: 请随便检查，这就是我们的矮人工艺！

say:0:1410208001:1.text:

say:0:1410209001:1.source_cn: 这杆骑枪在手中轻盈得令人惊讶，却蕴藏着风暴般的力量。\...

say:0:1410210001:1.text: The shield, thick and unyielding, is a work of art. Every inch is calculated, perfectly balancing defense and weight to withstand the harshest blows.
say:0:1410210001:1.source_cn: 厚实的盾身不是简单地金属堆叠，而是经过精心计算的铸造杰...

say:1:1410212001:1.text: Eldric, you've arrived just in time! There's been an issue at the mines today. Some raw materials got delayed, and they're only just arriving now!
say:1:1410212001:1.source_cn: 弗林，你来得正好！今天矿洞那边不知道出了什么问题，原料...

say:2:1410212002:1.text: Everyone's already deep into their tasks, and there's no extra manpower to move these to the smelting workshop. They're waiting on them though.
say:2:1410212002:1.source_cn: 目前人都已经安排开了，根本没有空余人手来运这批，但冶炼...

say:3:1410212003:1.text: What?! That shouldn't have happened... Wait!
say:3:1410212003:1.source_cn: 咦？！不应该啊，矿洞的人怎么会……啊，我知道了！

say:5:1410212004:1.text: Of course, we had that youngster help out with the welcome ceremony earlier. Seems he got a bit too distracted on his end...
say:5:1410212004:1.source_cn: 这真是，今天安排欢迎仪式的时候把老灰给叫过去了，估计是...

say:6:1410212005:1.text: Regardless of the reason, we can't afford any more delays now!
say:6:1410212005:1.source_cn: 不管哪边的岔子，现在的东西可不能耽搁了，弗林！

say:8:1410212006:1.text: When it comes to work, dwarves sure don't hold back. Now that's more like the ones I know!
say:8:1410212006:1.source_cn: 说到干活一点也不客气了，这才是我们熟悉的矮人嘛。

say:10:1410212007:1.text: Chief Eldric, since this problem began due to our visit, why don't we lend a hand?
say:10:1410212007:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，既然事情是因我们而起，不如我们也搭把手？

say:11:1410212008:1.text: I'd also love to see your famed smelting process firsthand.
say:11:1410212008:1.source_cn: 正好，我也想见识见识贵地的冶炼工艺。

say:12:1410212009:1.text: Oh no, no... How could we ask our esteemed envoys to do such menial work? It would be most improper...
say:12:1410212009:1.source_cn: 不行不行……哪能让耀光特使来干这些脏活儿累活儿？多不好...

say:14:1410212010:1.text: Eldric! Enough with your fancy words! The smelting workshop is calling for us again. We're needed!
say:14:1410212010:1.source_cn: 弗林！别客套了！冶炼所那边又又又又在催！

say:15:1410212011:1.text: Uh... I'll get more workers on this right away! We can't let our honored guests dirty their hands—
say:15:1410212011:1.source_cn: 呃……我立刻安排更多人手！一定不能让尊贵的客人参与生产——

say:17:1410212012:1.text: Chief Eldric, there's no need for such formality. Let us help! It can be part of the tour.
say:17:1410212012:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，别客气。就让我们来吧，就当是参观环节的一部分了。

say:0:1410212101:0.text: Please follow me to the forge.
say:0:1410212101:0.source_cn: 请各位跟着我一起去冶炼所。

say:2:1410213001:1.text: Every product you see here is crafted by our own hands—hammered into perfection, embodying the finest dwarven craftsmanship!
say:2:1410213001:1.source_cn: 这就是我们的冶炼所了，所有的成品都是在这里，由我们一锤...

say:3:1410213002:1.text: Ironbeard, it looks like there are plenty of workers here! Why'd you report a shortage?
say:3:1410213002:1.source_cn: 铁须，我看这里人手还足够啊！你怎么能谎报情况呢？

say:4:1410213003:1.text: There IS a shortage! If you don't believe me, go ask Hyla and see what she says!
say:4:1410213003:1.source_cn: 就是缺人手啊！不信你去问海拉，看她怎么说？

say:5:1410213004:1.text: I'll check with her later, but don't go raising a fuss in front of our distinguished guests...
say:5:1410213004:1.source_cn: 我待会跟她确认情况，但你当着贵客的面先嚷嚷起来，这——

say:8:1410213005:1.text: Don't worry about us. Observing and participating is a part of our inspection. Since we're here, let's speak with the person in charge.
say:8:1410213005:1.source_cn: 别介意！参观和体验也是我们视察进度的重要部分。既然来到...

say:9:1410213006:1.text: Good sir, Hyla can be... a bit brash, and she's not exactly a people person. Please let me handle this—
say:9:1410213006:1.source_cn: 特使大人！海拉……她脾气暴躁，不太会跟人打交道。还是让...

say:10:1410213007:1.text: It's perfectly fine. I'm not exactly a delicate flower. That's her over there, yes? I'll go say hello.
say:10:1410213007:1.source_cn: 没关系，我也是个粗人。就是那位吗？我去打个招呼。

say:11:1410213008:1.text: Ah... General, I'll join you then.
say:11:1410213008:1.source_cn: 哎……特使大人，那我陪你们一起过去！

say:1:1410214001:1.text: Where are the materials?! Didn't Ironbeard say they'd be here any minute?!
say:1:1410214001:1.source_cn: 材料呢！已经沸腾半个小时了！铁须不是说材料马上就到吗？！

say:2:1410214002:1.text: Ah, here they are! The new batch just arrived, and it's being sorted right now. They'll be in the furnace in no time.
say:2:1410214002:1.source_cn: 来了来了，来了！补充的这批刚刚送过去分拣了，立刻就能下炉。

say:3:1410214003:1.text: Honored envoys, allow me to introduce Hyla, our overseer and chief blacksmith. She's the best in the business. I've never met a forge she couldn't master!
say:3:1410214003:1.source_cn: 各位特使，这就是我们锻造的总负责人海拉，她可是我们技术...

say:4:1410214004:1.text: Hyla, these are the envoys from the Lightbearer Empire. They're here to inspect our work. We're all in order, aren't we?
say:4:1410214004:1.source_cn: 来，海拉，这是从耀光帝国前来视察的特使。咱们的锻造工作...

say:5:1410214005:1.text: Of course, there are no problems here!

say:6:1410214006:1.text: Just don't pull my workers for other tasks, change the schedule, or throw in last-minute requests—then everything'll run fine!
say:6:1410214006:1.source_cn: 只要你别抽我的人去干其他活，别随随便便改排期，别临时提...

say:9:1410214007:1.text: *Ahem* Please forgive her... Hyla has a bit of a fiery temperament, but that's only because she's so passionate about her craft.
say:9:1410214007:1.source_cn: 这、这个，见笑了，海拉她一直就是这个脾气……

say:10:1410214008:1.text: No need to worry. A little temper comes with the territory for top-tier craftsmen. As long as the deadlines are met and the quality is up to standard, we'll be satisfied.
say:10:1410214008:1.source_cn: 没事没事，技术人员脾气大是正常的。只要能赶得上工期，保...

say:11:1410214009:1.text: Of course! As for the deadline... well, I suppose even my reassurances won't set your mind at ease.
say:11:1410214009:1.source_cn: 那绝对没问题！至于工期嘛……口头说估计您也放心不下。

say:12:1410214010:1.text: How about this? Why don't you try out our forging process for yourself? See it firsthand.
say:12:1410214010:1.source_cn: 这样吧，不如来体验下我们这边的锻造流程？

choice_prompt:13:1410214010.text: How about this? Why don't you try out our forging process for yourself? See it firsthand.
choice_prompt:13:1410214010.source_cn: 这样吧，不如来体验下我们这边的锻造流程？

say:14:1410214011:1.text: Yep! We've optimized it all. It's simple to pick up.
say:14:1410214011:1.source_cn: 是的，我们这边已经形成了一套很完善的流程机制。

say:15:1410214012:1.text: Just follow the instructions and manage the heat correctly. Even a newcomer can forge a fine piece.
say:15:1410214012:1.source_cn: 上手非常简单，只要照着要求，控制好火候，就算是毛头小子...

say:16:1410214013:1.text: The final quality is reviewed by specialists before submission so it won't disrupt production.
say:16:1410214013:1.source_cn: 而最终质量则有专人进行审核后才会提交，不会影响到制造工作。

say:17:1410214014:1.text: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!
say:17:1410214014:1.male: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!
say:17:1410214014:1.female: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!

say:1:1410215001:1.text: This here is our standard production line. Just follow the indicators, and you're all set to operate.
say:1:1410215001:1.source_cn: 这是我们的标准生产线，各位可以根据指示操作。

document:2:143:0.text:
Main Material:
<style="highlight">Skyforge Steel</style>: Hammer it into a thin sheet and place it in the leftmost groove of the anvil.
Other Materials:
<style="highlight">Moonlit Silver</style>: Place in the second section, following the markings on the mold.
<style="highlight">Blackstone Dust</style>: Place in the third section, following the markings on the mold.
Strike the skyforge steel repeatedly with a heavy hammer to ensure it combines well with the other materials. During hot forging, monitor the temperature and reheat if needed.

say:0:1410215101:0.text: As expected of an Imperial envoy! The finished product is pretty good!
say:0:1410215101:0.source_cn: 不愧是特使，成品很不赖嘛！

say:1:1410216001:1.text: Impressive. It's such an efficient setup. And the weapons come out fast.
say:1:1410216001:1.source_cn: 真是了不起的生产线啊，这么快就能产出武器成品。

say:2:1410216002:1.text: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
say:2:1410216002:1.male: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
say:2:1410216002:1.female: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.

choice_prompt:3:1410216002.text: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.source_cn: 没想到我和<style=stress><player_name></style>第一次尝试就能锻造出这样的作品。
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.male: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.female: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.

say:4:1410216003:1.text: Although... the sharpness and durability of our blades seem a bit lacking.
say:4:1410216003:1.source_cn: 只不过……奇怪，我们锻造出的刀剑，锋利和韧性上，总是多...

say:6:1410216004:1.text: That's 'cause you were using the beginner's method with scrap materials. If you used our—
say:6:1410216004:1.source_cn: 那是因为你们用的是新人练手的工艺，矿料都是最差的边角料...

say:9:1410216006:1.text: Ah! My apologies. The production line still needs my attention. I'll be right back!
say:9:1410216006:1.source_cn: ……呃，抱歉！生产线还需要我，我先走了。

say:11:1410216007:1.text: Please excuse Hyla's... directness. She's a bit of a perfectionist, but don't take it to heart.
say:11:1410216007:1.source_cn: 不好意思，诸位特使，海拉容易得意忘形，大家别计较。

say:12:1410216008:1.text: By the way, we've got a tradition here. Tonight, we host a feast to welcome you all! It's a dwarven custom, so please, make yourselves at home.
say:12:1410216008:1.source_cn: 对了，晚上按照我们矮人的传统，得给各位准备一场接风宴，...

say:13:1410216009:1.text: A feast isn't necessary. But Chief, does your village happen to have any unique materials?
say:13:1410216009:1.source_cn: 宴会什么的就不必了，只是村长，贵村难道有什么与众不同的...

say:14:1410216010:1.text: Well, yes! Minerals and ores are the lifeblood of us dwarves. Without them, we'd have to find a new home.
say:14:1410216010:1.source_cn: 那个，矿产肯定是有的！矿产是我们矮人的命根子，要是没有...

say:15:1410216011:1.text: As for something unique... The celestrite we mine is quite famous. Though, I doubt it's anything remarkable for such knowledgeable envoys. *Chuckle*
say:15:1410216011:1.source_cn: 至于与众不同，我们的天青矿倒是非常有名，不过肯定入不了...

say:16:1410216012:1.text: But don't decline tonight's welcome banquet! The whole village has been looking forward to it!
say:16:1410216012:1.source_cn: 倒是今晚的接风宴，特使大人可千万不要推辞了，这是我们矮...

say:17:1410216013:1.text: I understand... In that case, I humbly accept.

say:18:1410216014:1.text: Like you said before, there's no need to be so formal! The banquet won't be ready until the evening. I need to go oversee some things for now.
say:18:1410216014:1.source_cn: 不用客气！宴会得晚上才能准备完，我得去那边盯着点。

say:19:1410216015:1.text: In the meantime, feel free to explore the village.
say:19:1410216015:1.source_cn: 这段时间我就先失陪了，各位不妨在村里到处逛逛？

say:20:1410216016:1.text: I'm sure many would be willing to converse with you!
say:20:1410216016:1.source_cn: 想逛哪里都随意！每位矮人都会好好招待你们的！

say:0:1410217001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't expect him to grant us such freedom of movement.
say:0:1410217001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't expect him to grant us such freedom of movement.
say:0:1410217001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't expect him to grant us such freedom of movement.

say:1:1410217002:0.text: Perhaps it's because he's confident we won't uncover anything...
say:1:1410217002:0.source_cn: 确实有些奇怪，或许，他们自信于我们不能探查到什么……
say:1:1410217002:0.male: Perhaps it's because he's confident we won't uncover anything...
say:1:1410217002:0.female: Perhaps it's because he's confident we won't uncover anything...

say:0:1410218001:0.text: Honored guests, the lift is under maintenance. This area is off-limits.
say:0:1410218001:0.source_cn: 尊贵的客人们，我们在维修升降机，这里无法通行。

say:1:1410218002:0.text: So much for unrestricted movement. Let's walk by the river instead.
say:1:1410218002:0.source_cn: ……我了解了。看来这里不能自由参观，我们去河对岸看看吧。

say:0:1410219001:0.text: There's a landslide. This path won't be accessible until repairs are complete.
say:0:1410219001:0.source_cn: 雨天造成了滑坡，得施工完毕才能通行。请先离开吧！

say:0:1410219201:0.text: Let's make the rounds and toast with our generous hosts... but remember to drink water, not ale.
say:0:1410219201:0.source_cn: 老朋友，我们分别与矮人朋友们碰杯吧……记得以水代酒——
say:0:1410219201:0.male: Let's make the rounds and toast with our generous hosts... but remember to drink water, not ale.
say:0:1410219201:0.female: Let's make the rounds and toast with our generous hosts... but remember to drink water, not ale.

say:1:1410219202:0.text: A bit of drink loosens the tongue, and a loose tongue might spill something useful.
say:1:1410219202:0.source_cn: 说不定会从喝醉的矮人们口中，获得新情报。
say:1:1410219202:0.male: A bit of drink loosens the tongue, and a loose tongue might spill something useful.
say:1:1410219202:0.female: A bit of drink loosens the tongue, and a loose tongue might spill something useful.

say:1:1410219301:0.text: Chief Eldric, your hospitality is truly unmatched!
say:1:1410219301:0.source_cn: 弗林村长，感谢你的招待！
say:1:1410219301:0.male: Chief Eldric, your hospitality is truly unmatched!
say:1:1410219301:0.female: Chief Eldric, your hospitality is truly unmatched!

say:1:1410219401:0.text: Miss Hyla, your skills are superb!
say:1:1410219401:0.source_cn: 技艺精湛的海拉女士，我敬你！
say:1:1410219401:0.male: Miss Hyla, your skills are superb!
say:1:1410219401:0.female: Miss Hyla, your skills are superb!

say:1:1410219501:0.text: Mr. Ironbeard, I hope the material shortage will be over soon!
say:1:1410219501:0.source_cn: 铁须先生，祝原料危机早日解除！
say:1:1410219501:0.male: Mr. Ironbeard, I hope the material shortage will be over soon!
say:1:1410219501:0.female: Mr. Ironbeard, I hope the material shortage will be over soon!

say:2:1410219502:0.text: Ha! That's been resolved! Let's drink!

say:1:1410219601:1.text: My friend, something doesn't sit right.
say:1:1410219601:1.male: My friend, something doesn't sit right.
say:1:1410219601:1.female: My friend, something doesn't sit right.

say:2:1410219602:1.text: Chief Eldric promised us free rein, yet we're blocked at every turn we take.
say:2:1410219602:1.source_cn: 弗林嘴上说着让我们在村里随意逛逛，实际上却限制了我们的...

say:3:1410219603:1.text: The lift is down, and the mines are sealed off... We're being kept at arm's length here.
say:3:1410219603:1.source_cn: 升降机用不了，矿洞也不带我们参观。只把我们局限在村子周边——

choice_prompt:4:1410219603.text: The lift is down, and the mines are sealed off... We're being kept at arm's length here.
choice_prompt:4:1410219603.source_cn: 升降机用不了，矿洞也不带我们参观。只把我们局限在村子周边——

say:5:1410219604:1.text: And doing a rather poor job of hiding it.

say:6:1410219606:1.text: I keep wondering... what exactly are they trying to keep from us?
say:6:1410219606:1.source_cn: 老朋友，我在想……矮人到底在隐瞒什么？
say:6:1410219606:1.male: I keep wondering... what exactly are they trying to keep from us?
say:6:1410219606:1.female: I keep wondering... what exactly are they trying to keep from us?

say:7:1410219607:0.text: If the situation is grave enough to warrant a secret envoy, then could all this tie back to their forged weapons?
say:7:1410219607:0.source_cn: 事情竟然严重到密使出面，这会跟他们锻造的武器有关吗？

choice_prompt:8:1410219607.text: If the situation is grave enough to warrant a secret envoy, then could all this tie back to their forged weapons?
choice_prompt:8:1410219607.source_cn: 事情竟然严重到密使出面，这会跟他们与锻造的武器有关吗？

say:9:1410219608:1.text: Agreed. We'll need to stay longer and keep our ears open.
say:9:1410219608:1.source_cn: 嗯，现有情报推测不出什么。

say:10:1410219609:1.text: And knowing Chief Eldric, tonight's banquet might just be another move in his game.
say:10:1410219609:1.source_cn: 看来，我们得多待几天了。说不定今晚的欢迎晚宴里，弗林村...

say:11:1410219610:1.text: Old friend, perhaps it's time to return to our usual tactics.
say:11:1410219610:1.source_cn: 老朋友，或许我们可以像以前那样互相配合。
say:11:1410219610:1.male: Old friend, perhaps it's time to return to our usual tactics.
say:11:1410219610:1.female: Old friend, perhaps it's time to return to our usual tactics.

say:12:1410219611:1.text: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.
say:12:1410219611:1.source_cn: 今晚，我负责喝酒……你就以水代酒，好好观察他们。
say:12:1410219611:1.male: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.
say:12:1410219611:1.female: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.

choice_prompt:13:1410219611.text: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.
choice_prompt:13:1410219611.source_cn: 今晚，我负责喝酒……你就以水代酒，好好观察他们。
choice_prompt:13:1410219611.male: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.
choice_prompt:13:1410219611.female: Tonight, I'll handle the drinking... and you stick to water while keeping a sharp eye on them.

say:14:1410219612:1.text: I knew I could count on you.
say:14:1410219612:1.source_cn: 我就知道，我们俩永远有默契。
say:14:1410219612:1.male: I knew I could count on you.
say:14:1410219612:1.female: I knew I could count on you.

say:15:1410219614:1.text: It's about time. Let's head back to Brimstone Village and see what kind of show Eldric has prepared for us.
say:15:1410219614:1.source_cn: 时间差不多了，咱们回深岩村吧。看看弗林村长又会唱什么戏。

say:17:1410219613:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我对自己的酒量有数。

choice:8:0:1.text: We don't have enough info yet.
choice:8:0:1.male: We don't have enough info yet.
choice:8:0:1.female: We don't have enough info yet.

say:18:1410219605:1.text: It's blatant, but we can't afford to act hastily.
say:18:1410219605:1.source_cn: 太明显了，但我们现在也不方便轻举妄动。

narration:0:1410220001:1.text: The welcome banquet is in full swing, and the dwarves are steadily getting drunk.

say:2:1410220002:1.text: General! You drink like a true warrior! Fantastic, fantastic! Your fortitude is truly something to behold!
say:2:1410220002:1.source_cn: 将军！好酒量！痛、痛快！特使朋友，了不起！
say:2:1410220002:1.male: General! You drink like a true warrior! Fantastic, fantastic! Your fortitude is truly something to behold!
say:2:1410220002:1.female: General! You drink like a true warrior! Fantastic, fantastic! Your fortitude is truly something to behold!

say:3:1410220003:1.text: Wait now, wait! I have something special prepared just for you. Let me fetch it, and then we'll drink some more—
say:3:1410220003:1.source_cn: 您等、等一会儿，我给您准备了好东西，等我拿回来，咱们再喝——

say:4:1410220004:1.text: Chief Eldric, there's no need to go to such trouble. Your hospitality has already been more than generous!
say:4:1410220004:1.source_cn: 不用客气了，弗林，宴会已经很丰盛了——

say:5:1410220005:0.text: Nonsense, my friend! This is something worth seeing!

narration:7:1410220006:0.text: Eldric stumbles away to retrieve a "surprise" for Hogan.
narration:7:1410220006:0.source_cn: 弗林村长离开，看样子是准备亲自去取那件“好东西”

say:8:1410220007:1.text: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?
say:8:1410220007:1.source_cn: ……老朋友，你怎么看这位“新朋友”？
say:8:1410220007:1.male: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?
say:8:1410220007:1.female: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?

choice_prompt:9:1410220007.text: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?
choice_prompt:9:1410220007.source_cn: ……老朋友，你怎么看这位“新朋友”？
choice_prompt:9:1410220007.male: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?
choice_prompt:9:1410220007.female: ... Old friend, what do you make of our gracious host?

say:10:1410220008:1.text: I thought as much. The craftsmen and villagers we met during the day, they were hearty folk, full of life, perhaps a bit rough around the edges.
say:10:1410220008:1.source_cn: 是啊。我们白天见到的工匠，在村里的村民，都是真的豪爽，...

say:12:1410220011:1.text: Take that lift, for instance. Guarded, off-limits, clearly not just a simple repair job. That must be—
say:12:1410220011:1.source_cn: 还记得那台升降机吗？矮人守卫着不让搭乘的那台。那是——

choice_prompt:13:1410220011.text: Take that lift, for instance. Guarded, off-limits, clearly not just a simple repair job. That must be—
choice_prompt:13:1410220011.source_cn: 还记得那台升降机吗？矮人守卫着不让搭乘的那台。那是——

say:16:1410220010:1.text: Mhm. He claims we're free to explore, yet every path we take is carefully steered.
say:16:1410220010:1.source_cn: 嗯，他嘴上说让我们自由参观，实际上却在刻意地控制着我们...

say:0:1410221001:0.text: Feast your eyes on this greatsword!

say:2:1410222001:1.text: This is... a magnificent blade! The weight is just right. The balance, the resilience, and the sheer strength...
say:2:1410222001:1.source_cn: 这、真是——好剑！份量恰到好处，这个手感，韧度，以及强度……

say:3:1410222002:1.text: How was this forged? For ordinary steel to hold such power, it would have to be twice as heavy!
say:3:1410222002:1.source_cn: 怎么办到的？一般的钢材要想达到这个水准，至少要重上两倍！

say:4:1410222003:0.text: Hahaha! This is one of Hyla's finest works, shaped by her own hands!
say:4:1410222003:0.source_cn: 哈哈，这就是我们的海拉女士亲手锻造的杰作之一了！

say:5:1410222004:0.text: I recall, General, that you wield a greatsword, do you not? The moment I set eyes on you, I knew this blade was meant for your grasp!
say:5:1410222004:0.source_cn: 我记得，将军您就是使用大剑的吧？当我今日看到您时，我就...

say:6:1410222005:0.text: Until now, I had never found a warrior worthy of it. But gifting it to you? That ensures it won't go to waste!
say:6:1410222005:0.source_cn: 之前一直没找到合适的主人，如今赠送给将军您，才不算明珠...

choice_prompt:8:1410222005.text: Until now, I had never found a warrior worthy of it. But gifting it to you? That ensures it won't go to waste!
choice_prompt:8:1410222005.source_cn: 之前一直没找到合适的主人，如今赠送给将军您，才不算明珠蒙尘啊！

say:10:1410222008:1.text: Chief Eldric, I deeply appreciate the honor. But a treasure of this worth... given my position, I cannot accept it.
say:10:1410222008:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，心意我领了！但这样贵重的宝物，我的身份不便收取。

say:11:1410222009:1.text: When my mission is complete, I shall return, and then we can speak properly.
say:11:1410222009:1.source_cn: 等这次的工作结束，我交了差，到时再过来，咱们再好好聊聊——

say:1:1410224001:1.source_cn: 呼，这矮人的酒真是够烈的，要是不注意点儿可能还真会喝醉了。

say:4:1410224003:1.text: Agreed. A blade of such sharpness is nearly unheard of.
say:4:1410224003:1.source_cn: 是啊，那样锋利的剑刃实在少见。

say:5:1410224004:1.text: Even the Royal Guard wields the finest steel, yet in all of Savannah, I've never seen a weapon with an edge that keen.
say:5:1410224004:1.source_cn: 按理说，皇家卫队使用的武器最好。但即便在赛凡纳，我也未...

say:6:1410224007:1.text: What do you make of it all?

choice_prompt:7:1410224007.text: What do you make of it all?

say:8:1410224008:1.text: Evie mentioned that every spy sent here never returned.
say:8:1410224008:1.source_cn: 伊芙说过，他们此前派来的密探都有去无回。

say:9:1410224009:1.text: I had assumed the treacherous bay terrain claimed them, that they met with some misfortune along the way...
say:9:1410224009:1.source_cn: 我还在想，是不是峡湾地势凶险，路上出了意外。

say:10:1410224010:1.text: But are you insinuating they were dealt with by these dwarves?
say:10:1410224010:1.source_cn: 你的意思是，他们都被这些矮人给……
say:10:1410224010:1.male: But are you insinuating they were dealt with by these dwarves?
say:10:1410224010:1.female: But are you insinuating they were dealt with by these dwarves?

say:11:1410224015:1.text: Since we've caught the scent of something, we should find a way to make them slip further.
say:11:1410224015:1.source_cn: 既然已经有些苗头了，得想办法引他们暴露出更多的马脚。

say:17:1410224018:0.source_cn: 霍根将军，这是呼金做的通讯器，有了它，即便不见面也能随...

say:18:1410224019:0.text: That will be useful. We'll use this to keep in contact.
say:18:1410224019:0.source_cn: 那可太方便了，我们就用这个保持联系。

say:22:1410224021:1.male: Don't worry, I can handle this.
say:22:1410224021:1.female: Don't worry, I can handle this.

say:25:1410224022:1.text: Magister, let's start by investigating that broken lift!

say:27:1410224011:1.text: That would explain why they've developed superior weaponry yet choose to conceal it.
say:27:1410224011:1.source_cn: 他们明明研制出了更出色的武器，却刻意隐瞒此事。

say:28:1410224012:1.text: If it were merely for profit, that alone may be forgivable.
say:28:1410224012:1.source_cn: 如果只是为了走私牟利，还不至于罪无可恕。

say:29:1410224013:1.text: But if they're secretly supplying arms to an enemy in exchange for something... that warrants the involvement of royal spies. The real question is—who are they dealing with, and where are they?
say:29:1410224013:1.source_cn: 但如果是以武器供给作为交换条件而通敌……那确实是值得密...

say:30:1410224014:1.text: I have my suspicions, but this is a grave matter. We must tread carefully.
say:30:1410224014:1.source_cn: 虽然我有些想法，但事关重大，谨慎为好。

choice:7:2:3.text: I still need to observe more.
choice:7:2:3.male: I still need to observe more.
choice:7:2:3.female: I still need to observe more.

say:31:1410224005:1.text: I was thinking the same. That drink was far too intoxicating. I didn't have much, yet my head is already spinning.
say:31:1410224005:1.source_cn: 的确……那酒格外醉人，我今夜没喝几杯，头却晕得厉害。

say:32:1410224006:1.text: Dwarves are known for their love of strong liquor, but this... this is beyond excess. Could it be they were trying to lower my guard?
say:32:1410224006:1.source_cn: 尽管矮人本就喜欢烈酒，但这酒也未免太烈了。难道说……他...

say:0:1410226001:0.text: The lift isn't guarded anymore. Let's check it out!
say:0:1410226001:0.source_cn: 主人！现在没有人看守了，我们先来看看这部升降机！
say:0:1410226001:0.male: The lift isn't guarded anymore. Let's check it out!
say:0:1410226001:0.female: The lift isn't guarded anymore. Let's check it out!

say:0:1410227001:0.text: The mechanism isn't responding. It's been deliberately disabled.
say:0:1410227001:0.source_cn: 嗯……升降机没反应，看样子这边走不通了。
say:0:1410227001:0.male: The mechanism isn't responding. It's been deliberately disabled.
say:0:1410227001:0.female: The mechanism isn't responding. It's been deliberately disabled.

say:1:1410227002:0.text: We'll have to find another way.
say:1:1410227002:0.source_cn: 只能去旁边找找别的路了。
say:1:1410227002:0.male: We'll have to find another way.
say:1:1410227002:0.female: We'll have to find another way.

say:0:1410228001:0.text: That landslide earlier was just a cover to delay construction.
say:0:1410228001:0.source_cn: 看来，下午打发我们的滑坡导致施工就是糊弄人的。

say:1:1410228002:0.text: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.
say:1:1410228002:0.source_cn: 费心隐瞒，矮人的秘密看来比我们想得要更大。
say:1:1410228002:0.male: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.
say:1:1410228002:0.female: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.

say:0:1410229001:0.text: Look over there! Some dwarves are still working.
say:0:1410229001:0.source_cn: 主人！快看，那里有几个矮人在往深处走，他们都没去宴会！
say:0:1410229001:0.male: Look over there! Some dwarves are still working.
say:0:1410229001:0.female: Look over there! Some dwarves are still working.

say:0:1410230001:0.text: Let's ignite the wood and see how they react.
say:0:1410230001:0.source_cn: 试着点燃木头，引开守卫吧。
say:0:1410230001:0.male: Let's ignite the wood and see how they react.
say:0:1410230001:0.female: Let's ignite the wood and see how they react.

say:0:1410231001:0.text: This is it. Throw the torch!
say:0:1410231001:0.male: This is it. Throw the torch!
say:0:1410231001:0.female: This is it. Throw the torch!

say:0:1410232501:0.text: Success! They're distracted. Let's sneak in!
say:0:1410232501:0.source_cn: 梅林，矮人守卫被吸引走了，我们快进矿洞吧！
say:0:1410232501:0.male: Success! They're distracted. Let's sneak in!
say:0:1410232501:0.female: Success! They're distracted. Let's sneak in!

say:0:1410233001:0.text: This place is massive! Hmm, what's that strange smell?
say:0:1410233001:0.source_cn: 好大的矿洞啊！唔，怎么有股奇怪的味道……

say:1:1410233002:0.text: Ugh, I smell it too! It smells horrible. What IS that?
say:1:1410233002:0.source_cn: 我也闻到了，呕，虽然难闻，但不仅仅是臭味……是什么呢？

say:0:1410233501:0.text: Let's find the source of it!
say:0:1410233501:0.source_cn: 我们在附近查查看吧！看看奇怪味道的来源！

say:0:1410234001:0.text: The dwarves are still using basic tools like pickaxes—that doesn't really match their advanced metalwork and machinery. Can such simple methods really keep up with their production demands?
say:0:1410234001:0.source_cn: 矮人的开采工具仍停留在十字镐等原始阶段，这和他们精湛的...

say:0:1410235001:1.text: The oversized mine cart carries ore from this very mine, judging by its color and texture. Yet, strangely, the material doesn't match the gift given to Hogan.
say:0:1410235001:1.source_cn: 矿车的容量似乎远超普通矿车的规格，从矿石的颜色和纹路来...

say:0:1410236001:0.text: There must be something deeper inside they're hiding.
say:0:1410236001:0.source_cn: 或许更珍贵的矿产还在里面，我们再往里走走吧。
say:0:1410236001:0.male: There must be something deeper inside they're hiding.
say:0:1410236001:0.female: There must be something deeper inside they're hiding.

say:0:1410236501:0.text: Unauthorized entry detected. Warning! Expulsion imminent!

say:0:1410238001:0.text: Whew... Those big metal things are tough!
say:0:1410238001:0.source_cn: 呼……这些大铁块真不好对付……

say:1:1410238002:0.text: That may have just been their first line of defense. Be careful.
say:1:1410238002:0.source_cn: 深处可能还藏着什么，继续前进。
say:1:1410238002:0.male: That may have just been their first line of defense. Be careful.
say:1:1410238002:0.female: That may have just been their first line of defense. Be careful.

say:1:1410241001:1.text: Helthor's beard! How did you fall from above?!
say:1:1410241001:1.source_cn: 赫托在下！你们怎么会从上面掉下来？！

choice_prompt:2:1410241001.text: Helthor's beard! How did you fall from above?!
choice_prompt:2:1410241001.source_cn: 赫托在下！你们怎么会从上面掉下来？！

say:3:1410241002:1.text: Oh, right. I've been underground for so long that I nearly forgot most surface folk only know Dura now.
say:3:1410241002:1.source_cn: 噢……不好意思，我在地底下住了太久，差点忘了如今上边大...

say:4:1410241003:1.text: Helthor is the <style="highlight">God of Mining and Metallurgy</style>! Our great dwarven father!

say:5:1410241004:1.text: He taught us to mine and passed down the art of forging... but that was ages ago, and he's long—
say:5:1410241004:1.source_cn: 他教会我们开采矿石，传授给我们锻造的技艺。不过那都是很...

say:6:1410241005:2.text: Wait, wait! No time for history lessons! You ruined my 3,672nd detonation experiment!
say:6:1410241005:2.source_cn: 不对不对……现在没空说这些！都怪你们，第三千六百七十二...

choice_prompt:7:1410241005.text: Wait, wait! No time for history lessons! You ruined my 3,672nd detonation experiment!
choice_prompt:7:1410241005.source_cn: 不对不对……现在没空说这些！都怪你们，第三千六百七十二次起爆实验又失败了！

say:8:1410241006:1.text: Ugh, don't look at me like I'm some villain.
say:8:1410241006:1.source_cn: 你那是什么眼神……像是在看大坏蛋。
say:8:1410241006:1.male: Ugh, don't look at me like I'm some villain.
say:8:1410241006:1.female: Ugh, don't look at me like I'm some villain.

say:10:1410241007:1.text: Explosives? That explains the sharp, acrid smell. It was strong gunpowder!
say:10:1410241007:1.source_cn: 起爆实验……你难道在制造炸弹？难怪我刚刚闻到了刺鼻的味...

say:12:1410241008:1.text: So what? I conduct my research underground. I'm not hurting anyone.
say:12:1410241008:1.source_cn: 那又怎么样，我在地底下研究炸药没影响任何人吧？

say:13:1410241009:2.text: We were blown down here because of you!
say:13:1410241009:2.source_cn: 我们不就被你给轰下来了！

say:14:1410241010:1.text: And you crashed into my experiment, little mouse. Let's call it even.
say:14:1410241010:1.source_cn: 小耗子，我还没怪你们砸坏了我的研究器材。

choice_prompt:15:1410241010.text: And you crashed into my experiment, little mouse. Let's call it even.
choice_prompt:15:1410241010.source_cn: 小耗子，我还没怪你们砸坏了我的研究器材。

say:16:1410241011:1.text: No, no, you first! Who are YOU?
say:16:1410241011:1.source_cn: 你这个人，明明是我先问的！你们先回答我的问题！
say:16:1410241011:1.male: No, no, you first! Who are YOU?
say:16:1410241011:1.female: No, no, you first! Who are YOU?

say:17:1410241012:1.text: How'd you end up in my lab? Are you here to steal my research?!
say:17:1410241012:1.source_cn: 你们是谁？怎么会出现在我的研究所上面？难道是想剽窃我的...

choice_prompt:18:1410241012.text: How'd you end up in my lab? Are you here to steal my research?!
choice_prompt:18:1410241012.source_cn: 你们是谁？怎么会出现在我的研究所上面？难道是想剽窃我的灵感创意？

say:19:1410241013:1.text: This is my domain! Don't act like I'm the suspicious one!
say:19:1410241013:1.source_cn: 不是……我为什么非要告诉你？这里可是我的地盘，别对我凶...
say:19:1410241013:1.male: This is my domain! Don't act like I'm the suspicious one!
say:19:1410241013:1.female: This is my domain! Don't act like I'm the suspicious one!

say:21:1410241014:1.text: Magister, this girl seems awfully shady...
say:21:1410241014:1.source_cn: 主人……这位矮人小姑娘很可疑。
say:21:1410241014:1.male: Magister, this girl seems awfully shady...
say:21:1410241014:1.female: Magister, this girl seems awfully shady...

say:22:1410241015:1.text: Yeah, what's your game down here? Spill it!
say:22:1410241015:1.source_cn: 矮人小姑娘，你们在地下鬼鬼祟祟地搞什么？从实招来！

say:24:1410241017:1.text: We won't go easy on you just because you're small! Chippy, prepare for battle!
say:24:1410241017:1.source_cn: 我们不会因为你是小孩子就手下留情，满满！拿起武器！

say:26:1410241019:1.text: Whoa! Put those away! There's delicate equipment here!
say:26:1410241019:1.source_cn: 别！先把武器收起来！我这里可都是研究设备！

say:27:1410241020:1.text: Hmph! We'll lower our weapons if you give us a good explanation!
say:27:1410241020:1.source_cn: 哼，想让我们收起武器，可以！那也要先看你能不能解释清楚了！

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 重点是你怎么会在地下！

choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 你在地下捣鼓爆炸做什么呢？

say:2:1410242001:1.text: Fine! Just stop waving those around, and <shk>don't damage my equipment!</shk>
say:2:1410242001:1.source_cn: 你们冷静点……收起武器！<shk>千万别弄坏了我的设备...

choice_prompt:3:1410242001.text: Fine! Just stop waving those around, and <shk>don't damage my equipment!</shk>
choice_prompt:3:1410242001.source_cn: 你们冷静点……收起武器！<shk>千万别弄坏了我的设备！</shk>

say:4:1410242002:1.text: You asked so many questions! Which one should I answer?
say:4:1410242002:1.source_cn: 你之前的问题那么多……我到底回答哪个啦！
say:4:1410242002:1.male: You asked so many questions! Which one should I answer?
say:4:1410242002:1.female: You asked so many questions! Which one should I answer?

choice_prompt:5:1410242002.source_cn: 你之前的问题那么多……我到底回答哪个啦！
choice_prompt:5:1410242002.male: You asked so many questions! Which one should I answer?
choice_prompt:5:1410242002.female: You asked so many questions! Which one should I answer?

say:12:1410253004:3.source_cn: 总之，我们现在意外掉到了地底，正在等那个矮人带我们回去。

say:16:1410253005:0.text: I see. No wonder the dwarves are in a panic. Looks like they've discovered something's amiss.
